subject.title: Dashboard: A2UI action-bridge capability — run canvas apps as dashboard widgets

question: Should OpenClaw define the browser Canvas/A2UI action-ingress contract first and then adapt dashboard widgets to it, or should the dashboard bridge own a separate A2UI action path?
rationale: The request crosses a product boundary and a security boundary: it depends on unmerged dashboard widget hosting and would route browser/sandbox-origin actions through trusted Gateway behavior.

options.title: Make Canvas ingress canonical first
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 defines the browser action sink, then make the dashboard bridge a thin adapter over that approved contract.

options.title: Sponsor dashboard-owned bridge
options.body: Approve a dashboard-specific action contract now, accepting that maintainers must review it as a new trusted-parent security surface.

options.title: Route outside bundled core
options.body: Decline bundled dashboard ownership and ask for an external plugin or ClawHub package once the needed plugin APIs exist.

recommendation.title: Make Canvas ingress canonical first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/68497 defines the browser action sink, then make the dashboard bridge a thin adapter over that approved contract.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the strongest landed signal for bundled Control UI plugin-tab direction and is also active on related agent-rendered web UI work.
